incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: eu-west streaming p99 spike > 2.5s (streaming tokens). Paging oncall.
Maya (oncall): I’m on it. acked page, joining bridge. any customer impact yet?
cs-rep: Seeing higher response latency for 3 paying customers in EU, support tickets opened. no 5xxs reported, just slow generations.
Samir (sre): Observing p95 up ~1s and p99 jumped to 2.6-3.2s in eu-west-2 over the last 7m. Streaming stalls correlate with router queue length.
Ivy (obs): Link to graphs: https://wavefront.internal/euw2/streams/p99 (short link). Logs show increase in queue-depth and repeated retries for the same shard ids.
Luca (routing): We did a routing policy rollout 03:12 that increased prefer_local weight for eu-west-2 to 85% to improve latency earlier today. rolling back now as hypothesis: policy induced hot-partitioning/hoarding.
Priya (infra): Confirming: LB connection counts to a subset of hosts in eu-west-2 spiked. health checks fine. looks like sticky routing cohesion to small subset.
Nikhil (eng): Can you paste the rollout diff? suspect we accidentally changed affinity decay parameter.
Luca (routing): snippet of the rollout config that went out:
```
- routing:
    prefer_local: false
    region_weights: {eu-west-1: 0.6, eu-west-2: 0.4}
+ routing:
    prefer_local: true
    region_weights: {eu-west-1: 0.15, eu-west-2: 0.85}
    affinity_decay_ms: 600000  # increased from 60s -> 10m accidentally
```
Maya (oncall): confirmed — affinity_decay got set to 10m. that would keep flows pinned and create hot shards. rollback plan?
Samir (sre): Immediate mitigation options:
  1) rollback the policy (preferred)
  2) temporary weight split: shift 35% of eu-west-2 traffic to global fallback (eu-central) via manual routing override
  3) drain hottest hosts in eu-west-2 gradually
Which should we do first? I can push rollback now.
Luca (routing): Rollback is fastest. pushing rollback to previous config in configstore now. will post runbook steps.
Priya (infra): While rollback propagates, I'll start moving 30% weight off eu-west-2 at the LB-level to reduce queue pressure.
ops-pager: Bridge created: https://zoom.internal/bridge/4832191111
Nikhil (eng): Reverting policy change now — applying previous values.
Luca (routing): Revert applied at 4832191234. propagation across edge takes ~30-60s per region.
Ivy (obs): p99 trending down — 1.8s -> 1.1s within 90s of revert. streaming stalls count decreased by ~70%.
Maya (oncall): Good. keep an eye for oscillation. any error spikes from clients after shift?
cs-rep: Customer update: drafted short note to affected customers: "Experiencing higher latency in eu-west; routing rollback in progress; impacts reduced". Sending now.
Samir (sre): Follow-ups to do before we close:
  - validate no residual hot hosts (host-level QPS and queue depth)
  - replay rollout gating to prevent affinity_decay regressions
  - schedule postmortem and communication
Maya (oncall): I'm handing off active follow-ups to Nikhil — Nikhil please own the post-rollback verification and postmortem draft.
Nikhil (eng): Taking ownership. I'll collect traceroutes, sample KV-cache stats and compile seq-length correlated latency table.
Ivy (obs): Action item: add an alert for sudden change in affinity_decay and for region_weight deltas > 0.2. I'll open the ticket.
Luca (routing): Root cause summary (prelim): unintended affinity_decay bump + increased region weight -> traffic hoarding on subset of eu-west-2 hosts -> queueing -> streaming stalls. will prepare precise timeline.
Maya (oncall): Oncall note: incident resolved for customer impact; p99 back down under SLO. we'll keep this open for postmortem and follow-up tasks. handoff: paging off, leave channel for async updates.
cs-rep: Customers notified. will follow up with any new tickets.
ops-pager: Closing bridge at 4832191478. leave notes in incident tracker: INC-2026-042 (assigned to Nikhil).
Maya (oncall): thanks everyone. good quick rollback. tagging doc owners for postmortem: @Luca @Ivy @Samir @Nikhil. :thumbsup:
